summary.text: Michele Magadance Skinner is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Jeff Smith.
A former journalist and recruitment business owner, she was elected to the Eau Claire County Board in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Michele Magadance Skinner's career experience includes working in journalism at TV-13 in Wisconsin, as well as in Georgia and Minnesota.
She also owned a recruitment business in Eau Claire, Wisconsin.
Skinner was elected to the Eau Claire County Board in 2024.
That year she was also the Republican nominee for Wisconsin State Assembly District 91 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Jodi Emerson.
She advanced from the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 31 on August 11, 2026.
